patch_description: Introduce a more parameter-efficient, symmetry-aware ansatz by: (1) merging pre/post corner rz gates into a single rz_corner and pre/post edge rz gates into a single rz_edge, (2) removing the ry_center parameter from Layer 2 and moving its center rotation into a new mid-layer, (3) adding a dedicated mid-layer of symmetry-shared RY rotations (ry_mid_corner, ry_mid_edge, ry_mid_center), while preserving ring CZ and CRX-ring entanglement and hub-edge CRX with a single parameter. This configuration reduces the per-block parameter count to 11 (from 14) and adds a compact, symmetry-guided mid-layer that can improve expressivity without exploding parameter count, aiming to improve validation/test performance and generalization while maintaining hardware-feasible connectivity constraints.
